item: In-app update: Settings > Advanced > Updates checks GitHub for a newer release tag and installs it (stop, git fast-forward, restart)
status: built; unit-tested with real git; click-through and a live update unverified
summary: Check for update asks api.github.com (guarded session, kill switch, one consent popup) for the highest vX.Y.Z tag; Update and restart is a separate confirm, then the app stops cleanly and scripts/apply_update.py fast-forwards main to the checked sha (origin pinned, clean tree, fetched commit must equal the checked one, dependency failure rolls back) and relaunches; installs that are not such a git checkout are shown manual steps; new App updates network lane, x12 locales; tags are not signature-verified.
